title: aphaeresis (fovariant-12)

freshResult.formula: Exists q0: cube. Exists q1: sphere. Forall q2: sphere. right(q2,q0)

referenceResult.formula: Exists q0: cube. Exists q1: sphere. Forall q2: sphere. left(q0,q2)

intendedConcept: There is a cube and there is a cylinder to the left of all cubes.
